description: This PHP file defines a class 'registry_v4' which extends 'registry_v3_1'. The class is involved in registering functions and complex types for a SOAP-based web service in the SuiteCRM system. It includes a method to register service functions like 'search_by_module' and several methods to register complex data types used in the SOAP service, such as search results, link lists, and module details.

classes.name: registry_v4
classes.description: A class extending 'registry_v3_1' that registers SOAP service functions and complex data types for SuiteCRM v4.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers the 'search_by_module' function to the SOAP service, including its parameters and return type.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex data types used by the SOAP service, such as search results, link lists, and module information.
